reviews.text: Morgan is our super trusted dog sitter: reliable, helpful, and affectionate. Highly recommended!

My dogs are really happy with Morgan. When we meet on the street, they always welcome him.
I'm very pleased with how I find them every time because I see his thoughtfulness and care for them.
Thank you, dear Morgan.
I've been leaving my dog ​​🐕 with Morgan for 3 years, and I've always had a great time!! Every time we meet on the street, he makes a big fuss over him, you almost want to go away with him. …

Morgan has cared for my dog ​​Lucky on many occasions, sometimes for extended periods, and over time he has become a valuable resource. He has a rare sensitivity and a special ability to connect with animals, which goes far beyond simple daily care.
He and Lucky have developed a deep, almost instinctive bond, as if they've known each other forever. A genuine connection has developed between them, built on mutual understanding and trust. Even today, if we meet him on the street, Lucky recognizes him immediately and runs to him full of enthusiasm.
Morgan has always been available and attentive, trying to meet my needs with great respect for the commitments he has made, including those with other dogs and their owners. He is reliable, present, and capable of understanding the needs of dogs in a profound and spontaneous way.
I can highly recommend him to anyone looking for someone who doesn't simply "look after" their dog, but truly knows how to build a genuine relationship, based on care, respect, and sincere affection.

I left my dogs for two nights, and it was hard to part, but in the end, Morgan assured me they would be fine, and they were. I found them happy and full of energy, and the celebrations after we left at Morgan's place made me realize they had developed a connection. Thank you, Morgan, and I'll entrust them to you when I need them again.

Nightmare Experience – DO NOT entrust your pets to this person!

I left my dog ​​with this dog sitter as an emergency, on very short notice, because unfortunately I had no other options. It was a forced decision, but I never imagined I'd find my dog ​​in such a state: dehydrated, hungry, and clearly stressed.
• Of eight carefully prepared meals (with extra portions if needed), only four were served. The dog sitter told me that "other dogs were stealing his food," as if that were an acceptable excuse.
• The water bowl was constantly empty. When I returned, my dog ​​drank two full bowls in a matter of seconds and pounced on the food as if he hadn't eaten in days.
• No photos, no updates: every request I made was ignored. The only calls I received were asking for extra money. When I asked for at least a photo, I promptly got nothing.
• The apartment was tiny and packed with dogs: mine didn't even have room to move, literally stuck.
• In 5 days, I never received any real news about how he was doing, only excuses and silence.

This person has neither professionalism nor empathy, nor even the basic conditions for caring for an animal. He's only interested in profit, at the expense of the health and well-being of the animals in his care.

I felt helpless and guilty, and I hope this review can prevent others from going through the same terrible experience. Never again.

I couldn't be happier to have found Morgan as a dog sitter! She's incredibly caring, reliable, and passionate about animals. She welcomed my senior dog into her home like part of the family, making him feel loved and comfortable right away.

Morgan has a welcoming, pet-friendly home, and you can tell she has a wealth of experience and a true love for what she does. She had all the patience and care needed to care for a senior dog, and that really made a difference for me.

My dog ​​came back feeling calm and relaxed, a sign that he had a wonderful time.
I can't recommend him enough—he's the perfect dog sitter!
Thank you so much, Morgan! 🐶❤️

Morgan is attentive and knowledgeable and offers personalized service with no surprises. You'll find your puppy just as you left him, without any trauma, dermatitis, or fungus, as I've experienced with other dog sitters in Naples. With Morgan, you're in good hands. 👍 …
We've been customers of the dog house for a year now, and I can say that Morgan is a serious and competent person. When our Vizla is in her care, we feel at ease! Highly recommended.
Excellent. Morgan treats the furry ones like his own children. My Flaka is very happy when she goes to him. Highly recommended.
